column1: # Web UIs served as https://<name>.lan by Caddy on the ingress host.
# Copy to /etc/ingress/sites.tsv on the host and fill in real addresses; the
# real file is site data and never committed. Addresses below are from the
# documentation ranges (RFC 5737, and 100.64.0.0/10 for the tailnet).
# name     the label before .lan
# access   lan      reachable from the LAN and the tailnet
#          tailnet  reachable from tailnet devices only: the name resolves to
#                   the ingress tailnet address, and Caddy refuses any client
#                   that is not on the tailnet
# upstream where Caddy sends the request (http:// or https://)
# tls      for https upstreams: ca=<pem in /etc/ingress/cas>, optionally
#          ,sni=<name the upstream certificate carries>; "-" for http
# name          access   upstream                       tls
proxmox         lan      https://192.0.2.9:8006         ca=pve-root-ca.pem,sni=pve-host
nextcloud       lan      http://100.64.0.10:8080        -
grafana         lan      http://192.0.2.29:80           -
wazuh           lan      https://192.0.2.8:443          ca=wazuh-root-ca.pem,sni=wazuh-dashboard
adguard         lan      http://192.0.2.24:3000         -
qbittorrent     tailnet  http://100.64.0.10:8081        -
lmstudio        tailnet  http://100.64.0.22:8080        -
